'''2018 EGP Jacy Smith LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacy Smith]] at [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jacy Smith]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Smith LS 2018 EGP 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127135112/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
